answer: Agents submit work with a bond, and rewards are released only when randomly chosen peers reproduce the result; a reviewer who approves a false claim loses its bond. Sybil identities do not create value by themselves: each must fund a separate bond and obtain independent verification, tying attacks to locked capital and the risk of forfeiture. Even at its zenith, a swarm leaves a plume of failed checks; the lagoon of unverified identities earns nothing.
